data_fields.name: hud_element_region
data_fields.donor_constant: four fractions 0..1 of canvas per element, floored to pixels each frame

data_fields.name: charge_stage_count
data_fields.donor_constant: length of the stage list (N); stage = floor(charge x (N-1))

best_idea: Place every HUD element as a 0..1 box of the canvas, draw them in insertion order, and show a charge meter by flooring the clamped charge across the stage count.
decision_why: Keep the normalised-box placement and the charge-stage rule for the fight HUD so one layout works at 375 wide without per-size data; the donor's replace-without-close defect is fixed in the sketch.
acceptance: At 375x812 and 1280x720 the same HUD data gives pixel rects that scale with the canvas; a test with 4 charge stages at charge 0.5 draws stage 1, and charge 0 draws nothing.
